data.exact_reserve_text: The annual accounting result for the 2017 calendar year is a loss of $87.8 million (2016: profit of $57.0 million). Unfortunately the severe catastrophe activity generated a pure year loss for 2017, this was mitigated to an extent by the positive contributions from mature open years of account, being 2015 and 2016, together with the positive movements on the closed years of account (2001 through 2014) that occurred during the calendar year. Profit for the financial year for 2015 account was $12,471 and for 2016 account was $3,975. Transfers to members' personal funds comprise the 2014 (2013) closed year of account profit. The amount of $55,148,915 will be transferred to members' personal reserve funds on 10 April 2018.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced significant prior year reserve releases in 2017, totaling -$130.863 million USD, representing a -43.23% release against opening gross reserves. This favorable development stemmed from positive contributions from the mature open years of account (2015 and 2016) and positive movements on closed years of account (2001 through 2014). Specifically, the 2014 year of account closed with a profit of $59.268 million, and the 2015 year of account closed with a profit of $55.149 million. The 2015 account experienced relatively benign loss activity, despite notable events like the Tianjin warehouse explosion and Germanwings Flight 9525. The 2016 account also saw favorable reserve development, which helped to offset the impact of 2017 catastrophe events.
